Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Core to Figma’s success—and heart—is our community. We care deeply about empowering our community, particularly through a time of rapid change in the industry, and one of the ways we can do that is through education.

We’re looking for a Motion Designer to join our Product Education team. They’ll use their knowledge of Figma, design, and pedagogy to teach our users to successfully adopt Figma into their toolkit..

Day to day, you'll create guided video tutorials for our YouTube Channel, as well as collaborate with other departments on other types of video content. You'll use your skills in motion and design to artfully explain complex topics in terms understandable by junior and prospective designers, empowering them to create.

Our ideal candidate is a passionate educator and collaborator, who is driven by their curiosity to solve problems and learn something new. They're an effective communicator and sweat the details. They should feel comfortable communicating concepts to beginner-level designers and developers in a way that lifts them up and helps them grow.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

· Manage end-to-end video production, from inception to delivery

· Collaborate with Education Designers and Content Strategists to create concise and clear scripts, and record voice overs

· Ideate new videos, record audio and video, create visual assets, animate, edit, write descriptions, and publish final videos to YouTube

· Create eye-catching motion graphics explainers, animations, and transitions to enhance and augment screen recordings

· Work with our Product and Engineering teams to understand how new and existing features work, and the problems they solve for our users

· Collaborate with the Marketing, Brand, Community, and Growth teams to coordinate positioning of our content for new features

· Identify key success metrics, perform lightweight analytics, and engage with our users in video comments

· Track record of creative, collaborative brainstorming on new projects and ideas

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
We’re looking for a Motion Designer to join Sierra’s Creative Studio and help define how our brand comes to life through movement. This role is ideal for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking—someone who can create standout motion work while establishing the patterns, principles, and frameworks that make Sierra recognizable across every touchpoint.
As a member of Sierra’s design team, you’ll partner closely with brand designers, marketers, product teams, and external creative partners to bring stories, products, and experiences to life through animation. You’ll work across product launches, marketing campaigns, customer stories, events, social content, and emerging brand initiatives, helping translate complex AI concepts into compelling visual narratives.
This is an opportunity to help build Sierra’s motion practice from the ground up and shape how customers, partners, and the broader industry experience our brand.

Create high-quality motion design work across marketing campaigns, product launches, customer stories, events, social content, and brand initiatives.
Develop motion systems, principles, and animation frameworks that create consistency and recognition across the Sierra brand.
Build scalable motion templates, guidelines, and documentation that
empower teams to create on-brand work efficiently.
Partner closely with brand design, marketing, product, and leadership teams to elevate storytelling through animation and motion.
Bring creative, from-the-ground-up thinking to brand campaigns and launches, exploring new ways to communicate Sierra’s vision and technology.
Help establish best practices for motion across digital, experiential, social,
and product touchpoints.
Mentor teammates and provide guidance on motion design craft, workflows,
and execution.
Explore new creative possibilities enabled by AI while maintaining a high bar
for quality, taste, and craftsmanship.
As a core member of Sierra’s design team, you will help shape the culture,
systems, and visual language that define our brand.

Proven Experience: 8+ years of motion design experience with a portfolio that demonstrates exceptional craft, strong storytelling, and the ability to build scalable design systems. Experience supporting high-growth technology, SaaS, AI, B2B, or consumer brands is preferred.
Motion Craft Excellence: Deep expertise in animation principles, timing, visual storytelling, typography, and motion systems. Ability to create work that is both visually compelling and strategically effective.
Systems Thinking: Experience building motion design frameworks, reusable assets, and scalable standards that enable consistency across teams and channels.
Great Collaboration: Strong ability to communicate creative ideas and partner effectively with designers, marketers, product teams, engineers, executives, and external collaborators.
Excellent Communication : Ability to clearly articulate design rationale, creative direction, and motion principles to diverse stakeholders.
Builder Mindset: Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys defining new processes, systems, and creative opportunities from scratch.
Creative Proficiency: Expert knowledge of After Effects, Premiere, Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite. Experience with Cinema 4D, Rive, Lottie, AI-powered creative tools, or emerging motion workflows is a plus.

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.
Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

About the Opportunity
Brand design is how Gusto earns trust, builds recognition and insight, and makes people feel something before they ever read a word. Our Brand is about how we show up in every moment and this team owns some of its most important attributes from how we use language to typography, from color and composition to illustration, motion.These aren't finishing touches. They're critical to how we show who we are and why we're different.
Gusto is expanding our in-house creative studio inside a fast-moving, late-stage startup. We launch products, educate customers, run brand campaigns, and show up at events—and we do all of it with a consistent visual language and voice that needs to work across digital channels, motion formats, physical environments and everything in between.

In the same week, you might be designing the visual system for a product launch and art directing an illustration library that will scale across the entire brand.
We're looking for a Brand & Motion Designer who is a hands-on maker: someone who loves the craft of visual design and motion, takes real ownership of creative output, and wants to help define how Gusto looks, feels, and moves across our brand. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on brand craft, motion design systems, and the variety of deeply considered visual work that makes a B2B brand feel genuinely human.
In this role, you'll own creative work from early concept through final delivery. You'll make judgment calls about typography, composition, color, and motion, and increasingly, that judgment extends to the AI-assisted work happening around you.

You'll know when a generated output is right for the brand and when it isn't, and you'll be able to say why. You'll help introduce motion as a foundational part of how we build brand as someone who thinks in motion and ensures it's part of the creative process from the start.
AI is part of how this team works. We use it to advance faster, explore more territory, and reduce the distance between a concept and something real. What we're looking for isn't just someone who uses these tools but someone who can direct them. Someone who sets the creative standard for what AI output is and isn't acceptable for the Gusto brand, and who helps us build the guardrails and workflows that let the whole team produce at a higher level.
If you're energized by being close to the work, care deeply about craft & preference, and enjoy improving both the output and the process, this role will be a impressive fit.

Design and execute visual and motion work across product launches, product education, brand campaigns, events, and digital channels
Design and evolve brand systems, including motion guidelines, templates, and guardrails, that help the broader organization produce on-brand work consistently
Integrate motion into the brand design process, establishing principles and patterns for animation that extend our visual identity into dynamic and digital formats
Direct and evaluate AI-generated creative work, setting the standard for what's on-brand, what needs to be pushed further, and what shouldn't ship
Use AI tools to compress the distance between concept and execution, exploring more territory, iterating faster, and raising the quality bar on every deliverable
Partner closely with other creatives and cross-functional partners across marketing, product, and growth from early concept through final delivery
Build repeatable templates and workflows that enable faster turnaround without sacrificing quality
Maintain brand integrity across a wide range of deliverables — including work where AI tools played a role in production — ensuring everything feels cohesive, human, and unmistakably Gusto

6+ years of experience in brand design, visual design and motion for in-house studios, agencies, or content teams

Robust design instincts across typography, color, composition, and motion direction—you know what makes work feel distinctive versus generic
Expert proficiency in motion design principles and tools—Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud and motion tools like Calvary, Rive and Lottie
A demonstrated point of view on AI in creative work — how to direct it, when to override it, and what it means to maintain a high creative standard when AI tools are part of the process
Comfort migrating between big, brand-defining work and fast-turn executional needs
Proficient collaboration skills across creative, production, marketing, and product partners
A maker mindset—you enjoy improving how work gets made, not just making the work itself
Experience developing or contributing to creative standards for AI-assisted production — guardrails, evaluation criteria, or workflows that help a team produce at a higher level with these tools.

Turn high-craft explorations into scalable design system contributions that reduce ad hoc implementation, improve consistency, and enable teams to move faster with confidence.

In this role, your primary mission is to act as the architect of our visual output. You won’t just be creating videos; you will be building the engines that allow our global campaigns to live across dozens of languages and formats with surgical precision.
You are the bridge between high-end design and massive-scale execution. While you will develop original creative assets, your core focus is on the technical craft of localization, template architecture, and AI-driven automation using the Google ecosystem.

Asset Scaling & QA: Maintain rigorous organizational standards across massive asset libraries. You are the final line of defense, ensuring that every export—regardless of the quantity—meets our exact technical and brand specifications.
Strategic Creative Development: Design the foundational "Hero" motion assets that serve as the blueprint for our automated systems, ensuring they are built from the ground up for scalability.
Your Technical Mindset
The Architect: You believe a project is only as good as its structure. You prioritize clean hierarchies, strict naming conventions, and scalable workflows.
The Logic Specialist: You have a deep command of After Effects Expressions and scripting, using them to solve layout challenges before they occur.
The Google Power-User: You are comfortable navigating Google Workspace, and leveraging Gemini/AI tools to optimize creative production.
Detail Obsessed: You are someone who naturally spots a 1-pixel misalignment or a slight tracking inconsistency across 100+ localized banners.
